reports.title: Taiko Audit Report (QuillAudits)
reports.description: QuillAudits review of the Taiko bridge, signal service, ERC20/ERC721/ERC1155 vaults and bridged token contracts on the based_contestable_zkrollup branch of taiko-mono, reporting four High findings in the Bridge and vaults. Fixes were verified on main at f7a12b8 plus a few follow-up pull requests.

versions.coverage: Bridge/vault review on the audit branch (engagement 2023-12-04 to 2024-02-27); the report pins no commit.
finding_ids: Unverified arbitrary data call allows attackers to bypass all validations and pass malicious message hashes directly to the signal service

reports.title: Taiko Findings & Analysis Report (Code4rena)
reports.description: Code4rena competitive audit (March 6-27, 2024) of the 81 Taiko protocol contracts in the contest mirror repository, covering the L1 rollup libraries, L2 anchor contract, bridge, signal service, vaults, SGX verifier and attestation, governance, airdrop and token-pool contracts. It reports five High and fourteen Medium findings; the sponsor-named fix pull requests in taiko-mono were not reviewed by the wardens.

reports.title: Taiko Protocol Audit (OpenZeppelin)
reports.description: Three-phase OpenZeppelin audit of the Taiko protocol contracts in taiko-mono: phases 1 and 2 at b47fc34 covered TaikoL1/L2 and libraries, tiers and verifiers, bridge, signal service, vaults, governance, token and grants contracts, and phase 3 at dd8725f covered the Bridge, QuotaManager, DelegateOwner, BridgedTaikoToken, BridgedERC20 and ERC20Vault. It reports 2 Critical and 3 High findings (H-02 only partially resolved), with fixes reviewed at the commits named per finding.
